items.explanation: Both have 4 thousands. Compare hundreds: 2 is greater than 0, so 4,205 > 4,025.
Both start with 3 thousands. Compare hundreds: 1 is less than 9, so 3,100 < 3,900.
6,450 and 6,450 have the same digits in every place, so they are equal: 6,450 = 6,450.
8,001 has 8 thousands and 7,999 has 7 thousands. 8 > 7, so 8,001 > 7,999.
Compare from the greatest place: both have 6 thousands, but 6,030 has 3 tens while 6,003 has 0, so 6,030 > 6,003.
